<!-- What changes for someone using pi-bg-bash, in a sentence or two. -->

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes.
- [ ] A user-visible change has an entry under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] A test changed to match new behaviour is named here and in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] A change to launching, killing or the crash watcher was tried in Pi with `pi -e <this checkout>`, on macOS if it touches the process port.
